# Third-party skills

The Unreal skills (`unreal-*`) and the cross-engine discipline skills in this folder
(`camera-systems`, `game-feel`, `input-systems`, ...) come from
[gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills](https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills)
(commit 184b72b, Apache-2.0, see LICENSE and NOTICE here), copied unchanged.

Project rules (Epic coding standard, CLAUDE.md, docs/architecture) take precedence over the
generic snippets in these skills. To update, re-copy the folders from upstream.
